rows: Write three strengths and three triggers, then ask a friend what they notice.

blocks.heading: Common Mix-Ups to Avoid
rows: Mixing up soft skills and life skills
They overlap, but life skills also cover health and coping.
Ignoring them can make things worse.
Talk to a trusted adult or professional if needed.
